$schema-doc: Single source of truth for SWU competitive formats. Edit this file to add a new format or to update a format's legal set pool. All three projects (retrieve-cards, swu-mcp, swu-ml) read from here via their respective formats.{ts,py} loader.

premier.name: Premier
premier.description: Standard 1v1 competitive constructed format. Up to 6 sets legal at any time; rotates in batches of 3. As of May 2026: SOR/SHD/TWI rotated out March 2026 with the launch of LAW. ASH/ASHP added July 2026 with the launch of Ashes of the Empire.

twin-suns.name: Twin Suns
twin-suns.description: Multiplayer free-for-all format (3-4 players, two leaders sharing Heroism or Villainy, 80-card single-copy decks). No rotation — every Eternal-legal card can be played, plus the TS26 multiplayer-specific add-on set.

eternal.name: Eternal
eternal.description: All released sets are permanently legal — no rotation. Launched alongside the first Premier rotation in March 2026.
